pull_requests.title: feat(api): add GET /loan-notices with readable due dates
pull_requests.body: Front-desk staff print return reminders from this list. GET /loan-notices answers {"notices": [{"loan", "member", "message"}]}, one notice per loan, and each message names the book and the day it is due written for people, such as 'Please return Dune by Tue 05 Mar 2024.'

pull_requests.title: feat(api): include page counts in GET /books
pull_requests.body: Each book in GET /books now carries pages, its page count, so the catalogue screen can show it.
